verdict_reason: An off-allowlist test case was dropped as a leftover of a reverted meter rename, which weakens the allowlist proof for no ticket reason.

todos.issue: aMeterOffTheAllowlistIsNeverRegistered drops its 'notification.sqs.messages' case. That name comes from an intermediate rename on this branch which f1c691b reverted (the meter is back to notification.message), so nothing in EUDPA-776 asks for the case to go. It was the one off-list name that shares the enabled 'notification' prefix in application.yml (management.metrics.enable.notification.message/error), so the test no longer proves that enabling two notification.* meters does not let a third through. Production config is unchanged.
todos.fix: Must: the off-list cases include a notification.* name that application.yml does not enable, as main had. One way: restore "notification.sqs.messages" to the @ValueSource.
